quality_check.description: A single vertical 9:16 layered paper-cut illustration shows the Red Horned Everyman behind an apple-sorting table at eye level. He has red skin, exactly two enormous ridged black horns with both tips visible, pointed ears, a long angular nose, heavy drooping eyes, short tousled black hair, a narrow pointed black goatee, two small lower tusks, and the muted red-and-charcoal plaid overshirt over a dark shirt seen in the character sheet. A slate-blue layered fatigue cloud surrounds his head, with a cream paper-cut brain carrying a soft honey glow. Nearly identical amber apples form an asymmetric diagonal foreground stream, while one visibly mismatched green apple sits near center. The scene is enclosed by the recurring thick cream card frame with an inset paper-cut window and uses cream, orchard green, slate blue, amber, and honey tones.
